name: Voxel Bricks
definition: A hierarchical culling structure where voxels are grouped into 8x8x8 bricks. Empty bricks are marked in a brickmap to skip traversal of their contents during ray marching.
summary: Voxel Bricks is a hierarchical culling method that groups voxels into fixed 8x8x8 blocks to skip empty space via a secondary grid, differing from other approaches by using a fixed two-level hierarchy.
